github.updatePath: in-app direct MSIXBundle download -> SHA-256 verification -> Authenticode/MSIX signature verification -> Windows package deployment -> restart

microsoftStore.publicVersionAuthority: Partner Center and the Microsoft Store client

releasePolicy.github: formal releases may be published more frequently after release approval and validation
releasePolicy.microsoftStore: stable versions are submitted only with explicit release approval; there is no longer a fixed x.0.0/x.5.0 milestone rule

github.policy: validated / frozen; future updater changes require a proven bug, security issue, or Windows platform/API compatibility requirement plus end-to-end regression evidence

microsoftStore.policy: v1.7.4 implementation is behavior-frozen; v1.7.5 is the final real Store 1.7.4 to 1.7.5 E2E target. One user action invokes the Windows-native combined download-and-install operation; register Windows restart recovery before it starts, use app restart only when the process survives, and keep Store and GitHub identities separate

documentation.storePublicationAuthority: Partner Center and Microsoft Store availability
documentation.runtimeUpdateManifest: docs/update-manifest.json is runtime/update infrastructure and is not the documentation source of truth

priorities: complete documentation governance and keep current-state metadata single-sourced
freeze and harden the updater with repeatable GitHub and Store end-to-end acceptance
standardize tool-page layout, state presentation, responsive behavior, and accessibility
make Project the context center for tool workflows without turning the app into a file manager
formalize project and backup schema migration contracts
establish startup, package-size, dependency, and native-component budgets
then deepen GIS/data interoperability and planning-specific productivity workflows
